learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about the beautiful colours of a rainbow and how to make our world bright!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Anandi was fast asleep. She was dreaming about a big bright rainbow! When she woke up, she saw a real rainbow outside her window.
Anandi loved the colours of the rainbow. She ran out to her green garden with her cute pet cat named Milli.
Anandi wanted to paint the white flowers. She used all the rainbow colours. She made them violet, blue, green, orange, and red!
Anandi left one flower yellow. She did this so the bright sun could look happy and yellow too. The whole garden looked so lovely!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw Your Own Rainbow
fun_activity.instructions: Take your crayons and draw a big rainbow on a piece of paper. Count and see if you have all seven beautiful colours!

quick_recap: ⭐ Anandi saw a beautiful rainbow outside her window.
⭐ She painted the garden flowers using the rainbow colours.
⭐ She left one flower yellow for the bright shining sun.
